caption: The drawing features a rectangular frame composed of thick, gray borders, with each side adorned by green and red leaf-like motifs and small green diamond shapes in the corners. Each of the four corners of the frame is marked by large gray circular shapes, each decorated with an inner green circle, a ring of small red and green dots, and an outer gray band with evenly spaced indentations or dots. At the top center of the frame, an arched, semicircular extension is present, outlined in red and decorated with a central green circle containing a red and green star. Radiating lines extend outward from this circle towards the edge of the semicircle. The overall composition balances the rectangular and circular forms, with the repetition of green and red hues against the dominant gray. The interior of the frame is blank, revealing the off-white color of the paper.
title: Lockwood Painted Mirror
